trajectory.text:
Available tools:
- get_email_html: Retrieve email content as HTML response for viewing in browsers. Decodes quoted-printable entities and converts charset to UTF-8. Pass your API KEY as a request parameter when viewing in a browser: `?
- extract_text_from_html: Analyze text for sentiment and broader concepts.. Extract primary text content from an HTML document. Cleaned page text is obtained by default in other HTML and URL functions. You can view the results
- scan_file_for_viruses: Scans files for Viruses and Malware On Demand. Virus Scan accepts a File URL and checks the file for viruses
- google_drive_update_file_permission: Read, write, and sync files stored in Google Drive from your mobile and web apps.. Updates a permission with patch semantics.

I'm heading into a meeting, so could you process invoice email msg_993821 by scanning the attachment link for malware? Once verified, please update the Google Drive permissions to give the accounting team writer access.
The tool successfully retrieved the email HTML containing the invoice download link. This provides the necessary URL to proceed with the malware scan. I will now initiate the scan on this link.
